en: The postcard shows a vintage black-and-white photograph of a harbor with several docked ships, surrounded by forested hills and early 20th-century buildings. The front is labeled 'Sundsvall, Hamnen.' The reverse features handwritten Swedish text, a Swedish stamp (10 öre), and is addressed to an individual in Dala Järna. Printed publisher information indicates J. Hellgrens Missionsbokhandel.
